repairs.quote: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an Ability, he sheds a chunk of Goo that can be reabsorbed to restore (4.0% ~ 8.0%) Max Health. Upon dying, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain after (8 ~ 4) seconds, he will revive with 10-50% Health based on the surviving bloblet's Health. This has a 300 second Cooldown.
